_comment: little-coder models override (installed to ~/.config/little-coder/models.json by docker/entrypoint-agent.sh). Points the llamacpp provider at the ai-stack llama-swap endpoint and registers the model ids llama-swap actually serves (qwen36-27b), which differ from upstream's bundled models.json (qwen3.6-27b). contextWindow MUST track (and stay under) the qwen36-27b per-request lane (ctx-size / n_parallel) -> 90000 for the 98304 lane since 2026-07-09b (ctx 196608, parallel 2). NOTE: the pre-2026-07-09 value 131072 was actually ABOVE the old 87552 lane (latent overflow bug). See ai-stack/.env 'qwen36-27b LANE CONSUMERS'. Restart little-coder after changing.
